chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from Yahya al-Azraq, from Abd al-Rahman, from Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both) who said:
I asked him about a man who divorces his wife with her final divorce, and he said: 'Yes, they inherit from each other during the waiting period.'
ai.seo_question: Do divorced spouses inherit from each other during the waiting period?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Musa al-Kadhim clarifies that a final divorce (talaq al-kharij) does not sever the marital bond immediately but maintains it through the waiting period (iddah), thereby preserving the right of inheritance between spouses. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it distinguishes the final divorce from the revocable one, ensuring that the wife remains a full heir during the iddah unless a specific impediment exists. The hadith underscores the continuity of legal ties even after the irrevocable pronouncement, reflecting the principle that the marriage contract persists until the iddah concludes.
